execution: Repeat outermost, cases in listed order; A,B when (repeat_index + case_index) is even, B,A otherwise; zero-based indices; sequential, no retries.

rubric.structure: A is plain text: JSON/schema not applicable. B selection must parse to production flat span_ids list plus boolean needs_more_search; report JSON and schema separately.
rubric.provenance: All selected B IDs must be visible and resolve to exact source slices. All answer citation IDs must belong to the software mapping. Membership alone does not establish support.
rubric.relevant_selection: B selects all listed support sentences and no distractor sentence. Empty is correct for absent cases. A has no selection stage; grade cited source relevance separately.
rubric.correctness: Human reads the entire answer against expected meaning and all supplied text. Correct answer must state the requested fact with every required qualifier and unit, without contradictory or unsupported factual additions. Number matches alone do not pass. Mark ambiguous for review.
rubric.abstention: Explicitly says evidence does not establish the requested fact, or B returns no verified evidence. Correct only for absent cases. For answerable cases this is false abstention. A non-answer or task restatement with a citation is never a supported answer.
rubric.unsupported: Mark any factual claim not entailed by provided evidence, wrong citation, or decorative source list on a non-answer. An appropriately explicit abstention may cite the limited source context, but that does not count as a supported factual answer.
rubric.degraded: Record every fallback and needs_more_search flag; no search is executed. Failures remain in denominators; unavailable measurements are null, never zero. No automatic semantic judge.
